# Estate Landscapers

> Landscape construction contractor based in Rouse Hill, NSW. Commercial landscape
> packages across New South Wales and Queensland; residential landscape packages across
> Sydney. Trading name of Apexx Enterprises Pty Ltd. Established 2019.

## Service areas

- **Commercial:** New South Wales and Queensland
- **Residential:** Sydney, concentrated in the Hills District and North West

## What Estate Landscapers does

Landscape construction, self-performed by in-house crews:

- Site preparation, earthworks and excavation
- Retaining walls, including engineered walls with piering, concrete, structural
  inspections and certification
- Landscape drainage — subsoil, ag lines, pits, surface falls
- Concrete works — driveways, paths, slabs, plinths, footings
- Paving and hard landscaping
- Fencing and gates — Colorbond, aluminium, timber, blade fencing
- Turf and soft landscaping — certified turf over premium underlay, garden mixes,
  mulch, decorative stone
- Planting, gardens and tree planting
- Decking, stairs, pergolas and outdoor structures
- Landscape design
- New irrigation installation
- Establishment and maintenance periods on commercial contracts

## What Estate Landscapers does NOT do

- Ongoing garden maintenance for landscapes we did not build (we maintain our own projects only), lawn mowing, hedging, weeding
- Repairs to existing irrigation systems
- Pressure washing and rubbish removal
- Small residential projects below the usual package threshold (complete packages generally start from $25,000)
- Infrastructure landscaping — road, bridge and highway projects (TfNSW, QMR and similar) are delivered by Infra Landscapers, not Estate. Subdivision and commercial landscape packages ARE delivered by Estate.
designer-led projects. Complete packages generally start from $25,000; individual engineered elements are assessed by scope. Retaining walls from 20 linear
metres. Turf, paving and garden areas from 100 square metres.

## Process

Enquiry, same-day call, discovery call, site visit and measure, itemised quote within
48 hours of the site visit, written contract with HBCF cover where applicable,
construction with set-out and drainage completed before surfaces, handover with
engineer certification where required.

## Projects (case studies)
- [Ermington Duplex Landscaping & Retaining Wall](https://www.estatelandscapers.com.au/projects/ermington-duplex-landscaping-retaining-wall/) — Residential, Ermington. Ermington duplex landscaping with 262 m² Sir Walter Buffalo turf, 66 m Colorbond fencing and a 41 m engineered retaining wall with drainage and sign-off.
- [Rouse Hill Boutique Home Landscaping](https://www.estatelandscapers.com.au/projects/rouse-hill-boutique-home-landscaping/) — Residential, Rouse Hill. Rouse Hill boutique landscaping with 92 m² turf, 36.5 m fencing, pebbled side areas, aluminium edging and a 21 m² composite deck with timber pergola works.
- [Newtown Duplex Raised Planter Landscaping](https://www.estatelandscapers.com.au/projects/newtown-duplex-raised-planter-landscaping/) — Residential, Newtown. Newtown duplex landscaping with raised planters, 76 installed plants, 17 m corten edging, Buffalo turf and low-pressure drip irrigation to six garden beds.
- [North Kellyville Boutique Home Landscaping](https://www.estatelandscapers.com.au/projects/north-kellyville-boutique-home-landscaping/) — Residential, North Kellyville. North Kellyville home landscaping with 63 m garden walls, 118 m² concrete, 23 m² floating steps, Buffalo turf and 22 m of Colorbond fencing works package.
